item.title: Newly formed Stark County Human Trafficking Task Force makes 1st arrests
item.description: The newly formed Stark County Human Trafficking Task Force has made its first two arrests -- Ohio men who allegedly attempted to meet minors for sex.

item.title: Cleveland church added to National Register of Historic Places
item.description: A staple in the Glenville area for 80 years is now on the National Park Services’ National Register of Historic Places.

item.title: Man convicted of killing traveling salesman executed in Florida
item.description: A man convicted of killing a traveling salesman he and his brother had met at a bar has become the first person executed in Florida this year.

item.title: 2nd Lyft driver fatally shot in Cleveland in 3 days
item.description: Cleveland police confirmed to FOX 8 News that a man found shot dead, slumped over in a vehicle on Cleveland's east side, was a Lyft driver.

item.title: Cost of Cleveland mayor's office renovations: I-Team
item.description: The FOX 8 I-Team has found at least one Cleveland city councilmember concerned about the amount of money city officials are paying to renovate the mayor's office.

item.title: Watch: Firefighters practice ice rescue skills on local pond
item.description: After nearly three straight weeks of constant below freezing temperatures, firefighters used a chain saw to cut through about 10 inches of ice on Brunswick Lake, creating a hole in which to test their rescue skills.

item.title: Berea parents expecting 3rd child celebrate big lottery win: 'Blessing from God'
item.description: A Berea couple expecting their third child this summer are celebrating early after winning a big lottery prize.

item.title: Winter temps and snow showers return: What to expect
item.description: Overnight we’ll be quiet and seasonably chilly. Temperatures will settle into the mid 20s with a little breeze from time to time. By early morning, snow showers will appear in the snow belt.

item.title: I-Team: Raises for top Cleveland Schools executives despite budget cuts
item.description: A FOX 8 I-Team investigation has found the Cleveland Metropolitan School District (CMSD) giving some top executives big raises even as the district is closing schools.

item.title: Person detained for questioning in Nancy Guthrie search
item.description: Sources tell NewsNation the person was detained south of Tucson.
